function rgb(hex): Rgb

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/procedural/shared.ts:41

Unpacks a packed hex color into [r, g, b] channel floats (0–255) — the canvas API wants css-rgba() strings, not three hex ints.

Parameters

hex

number | undefined

Packed color int (may be undefined → neutral grey fallback matching the catalog's default body tint).

Returns

Rgb

Channel triple.
